notes.label: weak rotation (wheat after wheat), dominated by seq-001

explanation.summary: For farm-001 over 3 seasons, sequence seq-001 (wheat -> rice -> mung bean) offers the best gross margin while staying within the irrigation quota; seq-002 trades margin for lower water use, and seq-003 is dominated due to wheat following wheat.

sections.water: Estimated water demand of 9500 m3 for seq-001 sits well inside the 45000 m3 seasonal quota; seq-002 uses 8200 m3 for farmers prioritising water savings.
sections.soil: Legume inclusion in seq-001 and seq-002 restores soil_score to 0.74/0.71 versus 0.52 for seq-003, where back-to-back cereals mine nitrogen.
sections.rotation_risk: seq-003 repeats wheat in season_1 and season_3, raising disease carry-over risk; no other candidate repeats a family in adjacent seasons.

evidence.title: Fixture evaluation results (S6)
evidence.claim: seq-001 scores gross_margin 5200.0, water_m3 9500.0, soil_score 0.74 and is Pareto-optimal.

evidence.title: Farmer profile priorities (S1)
evidence.claim: The farmer weights gross_margin 0.5, water_m3 0.3, soil_score 0.2.
